name: design-system-lifegames
description: Unified cross-platform design system for Lifegames — tokens, components, and widgets for web (Astro) and iOS (SwiftUI)

scripts.yalc:publish: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm --filter @lifegames/tokens exec yalc publish --push && pnpm --filter @lifegames/web exec yalc publish --push && pnpm --filter @lifegames/schemas exec yalc publish --push
